post.summary: Basecall Nanopore POD5 signal with ONT's Dorado into an unaligned BAM, `<input stem>.<model>[.<modifications>].bam`, that keeps the MM/ML base-modification tags and feeds `align` (`r1`) directly. Dorado is an optional tool the user installs; `download` permits model selection and downloads into `models_dir` (including chemistry/model identifiers sent to Oxford Nanopore). Without it, use a local model directory.

post.summary: Call CYP2D6 star alleles, including copy-number and CYP2D6/CYP2D7 hybrids, with Cyrius (about 30x WGS). On GRCh38 with chr22 ALT contigs, the locus's reads are first realigned to primary chr22 (needs `ref` and minimap2). Only a PASS call Cyrius matched uniquely becomes a PharmCAT outside call. Metrics: `cyp2d6_genotype`, `cyp2d6_filter`, `cyp2d6_call_status` (resolved, unresolved or no_call), `cyp2d6_call_info`, `cyp2d6_raw_star_alleles`, `cyp2d6_cnv_group`, `cyp2d6_cyp2d7_copy_number` (CYP2D6 and CYP2D7 together, normally 4) and `median_depth`.

post.summary: Call SMN1, SMN2 and SMN2Δ7–8 copy numbers with SMNCopyNumberCaller for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) carrier screening, not a diagnosis: one SMN1 copy is a carrier, none is affected; g.27134T>G, linked to "2+0" silent carriers, is counted. Short-read WGS of at least 30x only; below 30x median depth no calls are reported (files kept as `<stem>.smn.below_min_depth.*`), and non-bwa-like aligners get an `aligner_not_calibrated` warning. Metrics: `smn1_copy_number`, `smn2_copy_number`, `smn2_delta78_copy_number`, `sma_carrier`, `sma_affected`, `g27134tg_copy_number`, `smn_filter`, `median_depth` and `coverage_mad`.

BasecallParams.title: BasecallParams
BasecallParams.description:
Basecall Nanopore POD5 signal with ONT's Dorado into an unaligned BAM,
``<input stem>.<model>[.<modifications>].bam``, that keeps the MM/ML
base-modification tags and feeds ``align`` (``r1``) directly. Dorado is
an optional tool the user installs; ``download`` permits model selection
and downloads into ``models_dir`` (including chemistry/model identifiers
sent to Oxford Nanopore). Without it, use a local model directory.

download.description: Allow missing public reference/model downloads; no sample files or genotypes are uploaded. Hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md. Default: config allow_reference_downloads, else off.

input.description: A POD5 file, or a folder searched (recursively) for them.

model.description: Dorado model: fast, hac or sup (optionally pinned, e.g. sup@v5.2.0; picked for the run's chemistry), or a model folder (default: hac)

modified_bases.description: Also call base modifications, e.g. 5mCG_5hmCG (CpG methylation) or 5mC_5hmC; comma-separated for several. Writes MM/ML tags.

device.description: auto (Apple silicon GPU, else an NVIDIA GPU nvidia-smi lists, else CPU), cpu, metal, cuda:all or cuda:<id>[,<id>...] (default: auto)

read_ids.description: Basecall only the reads named in this file (one read ID per line).

regions_bed.description: Re-basecall only the reads --alignment places in these regions (a panel BED), e.g. with --model sup.

alignment.description: Aligned BAM/CRAM of the same run whose reads in --regions-bed are re-basecalled.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the POD5 file's folder, or the POD5 folder's parent).

AlignParams.title: AlignParams
AlignParams.description:
Align FASTQ reads (or a BAM/CRAM of long or Ultima reads) to ``ref`` as ``<reads stem>_aligned.bam`` (or ``.cram``) with its index.
``r1`` is required; the CLI's ``--genome`` may fill it in from a sample
workspace.

r1.description: Read 1 FASTQ (or FASTA of long reads), or a BAM/CRAM of long reads (PacBio is detected) or of Ultima reads. Short reads in a BAM/CRAM go through realign.

preset.description: minimap2 preset for non-BWA alignment. Defaults to map-hifi for PacBio and map-ont for ONT.

platform.description: Sequencing platform; selects platform-specific alignment tooling (default: detected from read groups or read names, else illumina).

aligner.description: Aligner to use. Auto uses bwa-mem2 for short reads when the reference has its index (see `ref index`), else bwa; for long reads pbmm2 for PacBio when installed, otherwise minimap2. bwa-mem3 (wgse-bwa-mem3 on Apple Silicon and Linux x86-64, else bwa-mem3 from PATH or its Pixi environment) writes bwa's exact records faster, from bwa-mem2's index.

fast.description: Align short reads with bwa-mem3's --fast speed preset (implies --aligner bwa-mem3), about twice as fast. Its alignments differ from BWA's (docs/hardware.md has a measurement); the run warns (bwa_mem3_fast). Without it bwa-mem3 writes BWA's exact records.

native_aligners.description: auto (the default, or config native_aligners) uses WGS Extract's aligner builds (Apple Silicon; wgse-bwa on Linux, and wgse-bwa-mem3 and wgse-minimap2 on x86-64) when installed on PATH, and on Linux without wgse-bwa-mem3 Bioconda's bwa-mem3 in place of bwa or bwa-mem2; off never does.

prefer_native_gpu.description: Prefer native GPU speed over the RAM-budget CPU fallback. Sort memory is stepped down first; explicit --memory is kept, otherwise at most 256M per thread. May swap heavily.

dense_suffix_array.description: Opt in to wgse-bwa's dense suffix-array file (``ref dense-sa``): the same alignments, faster, with the file held in RAM. None uses config dense_suffix_array, else off. Used only when wgse-bwa aligns; otherwise (another aligner, no file, or no wgse-bwa that reads it) the run warns (dense_suffix_array_unused).

gpu.description: NVIDIA/Parabricks (Linux, Docker): BWA-MEM short reads, minimap2 HiFi; docs/hardware.md#nvidia-gpus-parabricks. ONT requires CPU alignment to retain MM/ML methylation tags.

no_gpu_memory_check.description: Run on the GPU despite too little GPU or host memory; Parabricks' low-memory options are still chosen to fit.

sample.description: Sample name for the read group (default: the reads' file name).

long_read.description: Treat the reads as long reads (PacBio/ONT) and align them with pbmm2 or minimap2.

format.description: Default: BAM. CRAM is written with the target reference.

output_profile.description: Lossless output: default keeps --format; archive selects CRAM 3.1 (GATK >=4.7); calling selects CRAM 3.0. Default: config output_profile, else default. See docs/ont.md.

input.description: An aligned BAM/CRAM of the same sample whose header picks the reference from the library when ref is unset.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

input_ref.description: Reference FASTA a CRAM --r1 was encoded with (default: --ref when its sequence names, lengths and MD5s match the CRAM).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder, else the reads').

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

memory.description: Memory per thread, e.g. '2G' (sorts: at most half the RAM in all); None picks a share of RAM (default: config memory_limit, else auto).

AnalyzeComprehensiveParams.description:

SNPs and InDels called from ``input``), each annotated and filtered to
its significant variants (``significant_<type>_<name>.vcf.gz``; the
result's ``significant_variants`` outputs). Completed steps are recorded
in ``analyze.steps.json`` and skipped on a rerun whose inputs, settings
and tools are unchanged.

skip_calling.description: Without --vcf-inputs, don't call variants from --input; run only the BAM/CRAM metrics and lineage steps.

confidence_depth.description: (LOW, HIGH): read depth below LOW labels a call low confidence, below HIGH moderate (default: config confidence_min_* and confidence_high_*).

confidence_gq.description: (LOW, HIGH): genotype quality below LOW labels a call low confidence, below HIGH moderate (default: config confidence_min_* and confidence_high_*).

restart.description: Rerun every step, ignoring the steps an earlier run completed.

force_steps.description: Steps to rerun with the steps that use their outputs; None reruns none. Steps: info, mt-haplogroup, y-haplogroup, snp, indel, annotate, discovery.

dry_run.description: Log which steps would run or be skipped, and why, and run none.

input.description: The sample's BAM or CRAM.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the current folder).

two haplogroups (``haplocheck_contamination.txt``). Haplogrep reads

three more differences) is called at every site and mapped onto the rCRS
through the bundled alignment (``details.mt_reference``); a VCF on it needs
reference calls at all sites, and ``contamination`` its BAM/CRAM. Another
chrM that isn't the rCRS is refused: hg19's Yoruba sequence or another
rotation. One the header MD5, the reference or a VCF's REF alleles can't
confirm as the rCRS is warned of (``mt_reference_unconfirmed``).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

build.description: Override the detected reference build for this run.

tree.description: Haplogroup tree: yfull (the pinned YFull YTree release), yfull_v10 (YFull 10.01), ftdna, isogg, or a config.toml [y_trees.<id>] tree (default: config y_tree, else yfull).

tree_file.description: A Yleaf-format tree JSON to use instead of --tree, with its markers in --pos-file; QC1 backbone checks are skipped.

min_reads.description: Reads needed at a marker; VCF requires AD, DP or callable-block MIN_DP.

base_quality.description: Minimum read base quality; VCF also checks GQ when present.

base_majority.description: Percentage of reads at a marker that must agree on the base.

min_score.description: Minimum QC score of a reported haplogroup prediction.

no_ref_inference.description: VCF: use explicit genotypes only; otherwise --ref supplies bases inside callable reference blocks, never at unassessed sites.

assume_reference.description: VCF: assume --ref at absent markers for upstream Yleaf parity. Unsafe for variant-only or low-coverage VCFs: may bias the haplogroup.

qc_min_depth.description: Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 15, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

YStrParams.title: YStrParams
YStrParams.description:
Call Y-STR repeat counts from a BAM/CRAM into ``ystr/`` (a table and a
FamilyTreeDNA-order CSV).

input.description: Indexed BAM or CRAM.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

panel.description: Marker panel: FamilyTreeDNA Y-12 to Y-111, PowerPlex Y23, Yfiler Plus, or all (default: Y-111).

build.description: Override the detected reference build for this run.

min_reads.description: Spanning reads needed to support a repeat count (default: 2).

min_fraction.description: Share of spanning reads that must agree (default: 0.6).

min_mapq.description: Minimum mapping quality for single-copy markers (default: 20).

MethylationPileupParams.title: MethylationPileupParams
MethylationPileupParams.description:
Tabulate 5mC (and optionally 5hmC) per site with modkit (see the
module docstring). ``context``, ``hydroxymethyl`` and ``combine_strands``
default to config methylation_context, methylation_5hmc and
methylation_combine_strands, else CpG, 5mC only and strands combined.

input.description: Coordinate-sorted, indexed BAM or CRAM with MM/ML tags.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

region.description: Region(s), 1-based and inclusive: chr20:10000000-11000000 or chr1,chr2 (default: the whole genome)

context.description: cpg: CpG sites only; all: every cytosine (CHG/CHH too). Overrides methylation_context in config.toml (default: cpg).

hydroxymethyl.description: Also report 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (Nanopore 5mCG_5hmCG models). Overrides methylation_5hmc in config.toml (default: 5mC only).

combine_strands.description: Sum both strands of each CpG into one row on its C. True with context 'all' is an error; the config default quietly gives way.

table_format.description: Summary table format: tsv, or parquet (needs pyarrow), which also writes the sites as <stem>.<context>.bedmethyl.parquet (default: tsv)

MicroarrayParams.title: MicroarrayParams
MicroarrayParams.description:
Generate a combined 23andMe-style kit and the selected vendor or AADR
formats from a BAM, CRAM or VCF.

download.description: Allow missing public reference/model downloads; no sample files or genotypes are uploaded. Hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md. Default: config allow_reference_downloads, else off.

input.description: BAM, CRAM or VCF to genotype.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

formats.description: Comma-separated formats to generate, e.g. "23andme_v5,ancestry_v2" (default: "all", the combined kit only); see `wgsextract microarray --help` for the list.

table_format.description: Also save the genotypes as <input>_genotypes.tsv or .parquet (needs pyarrow): rsID, chrom, pos (in the input's build) and genotype. None saves no table.

strand_ambiguous.description: Keep/no-call biallelic A/T or C/G input SNPs; unknown probe alleles are not inferred (default: config or keep)

resolve_rsids.description: Resolve packaged dbSNP aliases and no-call retired/ambiguous marker IDs (default: config or false)

quirks.description: corrected: forward-strand calls; vendor: reverse-strand calls where a template's vendor revision reported them so (default: config or corrected)

min_gq.description: Minimum sample GQ; missing GQ becomes a no-call (default: config or 20; 0 disables filtering)

min_dp.description: Minimum sample DP; missing DP becomes a no-call (default: config or 10; 0 disables filtering)

assume_hom_ref.description: Assume absent VCF markers are reference on represented contigs (unsafe opt-in; default: config or false; also requires --min-dp 0 --min-gq 0)

exclude_filtered.description: No-call VCF records failing FILTER (default: config or true)

call_reasons.description: Also write CombinedKit_reasons.tsv with explicit reasons (default: config or false)

aadr_sample_id.description: Non-identifying sample label for AADR .fam/.ind (default: sample)

aadr_sex.description: AADR metadata sex only; does not change genotype calling (default: U)

parallel.description: Call chromosomes in parallel workers (default: on with --threads above 1; calls are identical to one stream)

ref_vcf_tab.description: Master tabulated list of all consumer microarray SNPs (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)

ploidy_file.description: File defining ploidy per chromosome (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)

sample.description: Sample to use from a multi-sample VCF (e.g. a joint-called nf-core/sarek VCF); required when the VCF has more than one

qc_min_depth.description: Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 15, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

PanelBedParams.title: PanelBedParams
PanelBedParams.description: Write a BED of padded, merged gene regions for adaptive sampling.

gene_file.description: File of gene symbols, one per line (or comma- or space-separated; # starts a comment)

presets.description: Gene preset (repeatable): pharmacogenes, hla, autoimmune, acmg-sf, cardiac

build.description: Coordinates of hg38 (GRCh38), t2t (CHM13v2.0) or hg19 (GRCh37) (default: --ref's build, else hg38)

pad_kb.description: Padding added to each side of every gene, in kb (default: 100)

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the current folder).

list_presets.description: List the presets, their sources and genes; writes no files.

PetAlignParams.title: PetAlignParams
PetAlignParams.description:
Align a dog's or cat's FASTQ reads to ``ref`` and call its variants.
``ref`` is the species' FASTA, or a reference library whose ``genomes``
folder holds the NCBI reference (``ref library --install``). ``r1`` is
required; the CLI's ``--genome`` may fill it in from a sample workspace.

format.description: Output format of the alignment: BAM or CRAM.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the reads' folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

memory.description: Memory per thread, e.g. '2G' (sorts: at most half the RAM in all); None picks a share of RAM (default: config memory_limit, else auto).

FastpParams.title: FastpParams
FastpParams.description:
Trim and filter reads with fastp into ``<reads>_fp_1.fastq.gz`` (and
``_fp_2`` for pairs) plus JSON and HTML reports. The read counts, Q30
rate and duplication rate are metrics.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the R1 file's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

FastqcParams.title: FastqcParams
FastqcParams.description:
A FastQC report on a FASTQ, BAM or SAM file as ``<input>_fastqc.html``
and ``.zip``, and on ``r2`` too when set. Module PASS/WARN/FAIL counts and
the read count are metrics (``r2_``-prefixed for ``r2``). With ``r2``,
``multiqc`` merges the reports in ``outdir`` into ``multiqc_report.html``.

input.description: FASTQ, BAM or SAM file.

multiqc.description: With r2, merge the reports in outdir into ``multiqc_report.html``, replacing an earlier one.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

MultiqcParams.title: MultiqcParams
MultiqcParams.description:
One MultiQC HTML report, ``multiqc_report.html``, from FastQC reports,
``bcftools stats`` files and WGS Extract result manifests. Runs offline,
with MultiQC's AI summaries off.

input.description: A report or result manifest, or a folder searched for them.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input folder, or the input's folder).

force.description: Replace an existing report instead of failing.

MultiqcMetricsParams.title: MultiqcMetricsParams
MultiqcMetricsParams.description:
MultiQC custom-content files (``wgsextract_*_mqc.json``) from the
metrics in WGS Extract result manifests; MultiQC isn't needed.

input.description: A result manifest, or a folder searched for them.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input folder, or the input's folder).

QcVcfParams.title: QcVcfParams
QcVcfParams.description:
``bcftools stats`` on a VCF as ``<vcf>.vcfstats.txt``; record, SNP and
indel counts and Ts/Tv are metrics. Set ``input`` or ``vcf_input``; the
latter wins.

input.description: VCF file.

vcf_input.description: VCF file.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

QcContaminationParams.title: QcContaminationParams
QcContaminationParams.description:
Estimate how much of a BAM/CRAM's DNA comes from another person
(FREEMIX) with VerifyBamID2 at 1000 Genomes sites (GRCh37/hg19 or
GRCh38). Writes ``<stem>.contamination.selfSM`` and ``.Ancestry``.
Metrics: ``freemix``, ``freemix_sites``, ``freemix_depth`` and the
ancestry PCs; recorded as the sample's ``contamination`` fact. Optional
(``pixi install -e verifybamid2``); not on Windows.

input.description: Indexed BAM or CRAM aligned to GRCh37/hg19 or GRCh38.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

sites.description: 1000 Genomes marker set: 100k (default) or 10k, faster and noisier, for low coverage

svd_prefix.description: Your own VerifyBamID2 resource prefix (``<prefix>.UD``, ``.mu``, ``.bed``, ``.V``); any build is then accepted. None uses the bundled 1000 Genomes resources for the input's build.

RelateParams.title: RelateParams
RelateParams.description: Sex, relatedness and continental ancestry with somalier.

inputs.description: BAM, CRAM or VCF files, or .somalier sketches from an earlier run.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the first input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

sites.description: Sites VCF to genotype instead of somalier's own for the input's build (default: from 'ref somalier --install').

ped.description: PED/FAM file of the expected relationships and sexes; pairs or sexes that disagree are flagged as possible sample swaps.

ancestry.description: Predict the 1000 Genomes superpopulation (default: when 'ref somalier --install' has installed the labelled sketches).

table_format.description: Table format: tsv, or parquet (needs pyarrow) (default: tsv)

QcAncestryParams.title: QcAncestryParams
QcAncestryParams.description:
Admixture-style proportions of 7 continental and 12 sub-continental
HGDP+1KG reference components (not an ethnicity), with 95% intervals,
from a BAM/CRAM, VCF or microarray file. Writes ``<stem>.ancestry.tsv``
and the ``ancestry`` fact; see docs/ancestry.md.

download.description: Allow missing public reference/model downloads; no sample files or genotypes are uploaded. Hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md. Default: config allow_reference_downloads, else off.

input.description: Indexed BAM or CRAM, VCF, or microarray raw-data file.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

sample.description: The sample of a multi-sample VCF

build.description: The input's build, when its header doesn't tell

bootstrap.description: Bootstrap replicates for the 95% intervals; 0 skips them

FakeDataParams.title: FakeDataParams
FakeDataParams.description:
Generate a small fake genome for tests: reference, reads and calls
named ``fake*``, reproducible from ``seed``. Uses the build's installed
reference when there is one.

types.description: Comma-separated list of types to generate (vcf, cram, bam, fastq, all). Default: cram

full_size.description: Use real human chromosome lengths. The default scaled mode uses shorter chromosomes.

legacy_bam.description: Use the older scaled fake BAM generator. Slower and unavailable with --full-size, but includes randomized placement and indel CIGARs.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the current folder).

RefAadrParams.title: RefAadrParams
RefAadrParams.description:
Install the hash-pinned CC0 AADR v66.p1 2M SNP panel into the library,
or delete it. ``ref bootstrap`` does not install it: the Harvard Dataverse
server is slow, so the panel is only downloaded on request.

delete.description: Delete the installed AADR 2M SNP panel

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefSomalierParams.title: RefSomalierParams
RefSomalierParams.description:
Install somalier's hash-pinned sites files (MIT) and the labelled
1000 Genomes sketches (CC BY 4.0, Zenodo 3479773) that ``qc relate``
uses, about 85 MB, or delete them.

delete.description: Delete the installed somalier sites and 1000 Genomes sketches

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefImputationParams.title: RefImputationParams
RefImputationParams.description:
Install SHA-256-pinned GRCh38 1000 Genomes 30x panel chromosomes
and prepare GLIMPSE2 binary references, or delete installed chromosomes.

delete.description: Delete the installed imputation panel chromosomes

chromosomes.description: Chromosomes: chr20, chr1-22 or all (autosomes only).

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

RefAncestryParams.title: RefAncestryParams
RefAncestryParams.description:
Install the hash-pinned ancestry reference of ``qc ancestry``, or
delete it.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefGnomadSvParams.title: RefGnomadSvParams
RefGnomadSvParams.description:
Install the gnomAD structural-variant sites tables that ``vcf sv-freq``
matches SV calls against, or delete them. Each sites VCF is checked
against a pinned SHA-256, reduced to a small table and deleted. gnomAD
data have no use restriction.

source.description: sr: gnomAD-SV (GRCh38, GRCh37). lr: gnomAD-LR (GRCh38, 53 GB).

delete.description: Delete the installed gnomAD SV tables

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefYbrowseParams.title: RefYbrowseParams
RefYbrowseParams.description:
Install a hash-pinned, sites-only GRCh38 yBrowse snapshot into the
library, or delete the installed snapshots.

snapshot.description: Use a local GRCh38 VCF(.gz), verifying its header instead of the upstream pin.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefIndexParams.title: RefIndexParams
RefIndexParams.description:
Index a FASTA: ``.fai`` (and ``.gzi``), the ``.dict`` sequence
dictionary and the aligner's index, written beside it.

download.description: Allow missing public reference/model downloads; no sample files or genotypes are uploaded. Hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md. Default: config allow_reference_downloads, else off.

ref.description: The reference FASTA (required; default: config reference_fasta).

aligner.description: Aligner index to make. bwa-mem2's maps faster but takes 17 GB of memory for a human genome; --download permits fetching hs38DH's, others need ~90 GB of memory to build.

RefDenseSaParams.title: RefDenseSaParams
RefDenseSaParams.description:
Build wgse-bwa's optional dense suffix-array file for a FASTA's BWA
index (``<ref>.wgse-sa<interval>``, 0.8 GB for hs38 at 16), list the
FASTA's files, or delete them. Needs wgse-bwa 0.11.0 or later on PATH;
``align``/``realign`` read the file only when asked
(``dense_suffix_array``).

ref.description: The reference FASTA (required; default: config reference_fasta).

interval.description: Store the suffix-array position of every Nth row. A smaller N locates seeds faster but doubles the file each halving (0.8 GB for hs38 at 16, the default).

list_files.description: List the FASTA's dense suffix-array files, their size, and the one wgse-bwa would read on this computer.

delete.description: Delete the FASTA's dense suffix-array files.

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

RefCountNsParams.title: RefCountNsParams
RefCountNsParams.description:
Count the FASTA's N runs into ``<ref>_ncnt.csv`` and ``<ref>_nbin.csv``;
sequence, length and N totals are metrics.

ref.description: The reference FASTA (required; default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Folder for the N-count files (default: beside the FASTA; config output_directory is not used).

RefVerifyParams.title: RefVerifyParams
RefVerifyParams.description:
Check a FASTA's compression, its ``.fai``/``.gzi`` and ``.dict`` against
the file, and its sequence signature against the library catalog. Writes
a missing ``.fai``/``.gzi``; ``contigs`` and ``signature`` are metrics.

ref.description: The reference FASTA, or a folder holding one (required; default: config reference_fasta).

RefLibraryParams.title: RefLibraryParams
RefLibraryParams.description:
Install a catalog genome into the library's ``genomes`` folder, trying
each mirror that hosts it.

install.description: The genome's catalog code (e.g. hs38) or 1-based index (required).

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefLibraryListParams.title: RefLibraryListParams
RefLibraryListParams.description:
List the catalog's genomes with their status in the library (installed,
unindexed, incomplete or missing), size, N counts and VEP cache, then the
gene maps and annotation data it holds.

ref.description: Reference library folder, or a FASTA in it (default: config reference_fasta's library, else reference_library, else the default library).

remote_sizes.description: Look up the download size of each genome whose size isn't cached (HTTP HEAD or FTP SIZE, ~8 s at most) and save it in the library's cache for 30 days.

RefLibraryDeleteParams.title: RefLibraryDeleteParams
RefLibraryDeleteParams.description:
Delete a catalog genome from the library's genomes folder: its FASTA,
a partial download, its indexes and sequence dictionary. Its N counts,
which never change, stay.

genome.description: The genome's catalog code (e.g. hs38) or file name (e.g. hs38.fa.gz) (required).

ref.description: Reference library folder, or a FASTA in it (default: config reference_fasta's library, else reference_library, else the default library).

RefStatusParams.title: RefStatusParams
RefStatusParams.description:
What the reference library holds, as the result's ``details``: genomes
and their indexes, annotation data, gene maps, VEP cache, PharmCAT,
ploidy and mappability files, and the test genome.

ref.description: Reference library folder, or a FASTA in it (default: config reference_library, else reference_fasta's library, else the default library).

input.description: A BAM/CRAM or VCF whose build picks the annotation files to report.

mygenomes_library.description: My Genomes library folder for the test genome (default: config mygenomes_library, else mygenomes/ in the users workspace).

annotation_vcf.description: Custom annotation VCF path to include in readiness checks.

RefTestGenomeParams.title: RefTestGenomeParams

ref.description: Reference library folder, or a FASTA in it (default: config reference_library, else reference_fasta's library, else the default library).

mygenomes_library.description: My Genomes library folder for the test genome (default: config mygenomes_library, else mygenomes/ in the users workspace).

install.description: Download the test genome (84 MB, SHA-256 checked) and unpack it.

delete.description: Delete the test genome and its download.

RefCytobandsParams.title: RefCytobandsParams
RefCytobandsParams.description:
Validate installed UCSC cytobands; fetch a missing table only with
``--download``. Installs primary-chromosome hg19/hg38 ideograms for the
offline viewer; no sample data is sent.

download.description: Download missing UCSC cytoBand data from hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu; only the public assembly URL is requested, never sample data.

ref.description: Reference library folder (default: config reference_library); an explicit FASTA resolves its library.

RefGeneMapParams.title: RefGeneMapParams
RefGeneMapParams.description: Download the hg19 and hg38 gene maps into the library, or delete them.

delete.description: Delete gene maps instead of downloading

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefClinvarParams.title: RefClinvarParams
RefClinvarParams.description: Download the official ClinVar VCF for hg19 and hg38.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefRevelParams.title: RefRevelParams
RefRevelParams.description: Download REVEL pathogenicity scores for hg19 and hg38.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefPhylopParams.title: RefPhylopParams
RefPhylopParams.description: Download UCSC's PhyloP 100-way conservation scores (~10 GB bigWig).

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefGnomadParams.title: RefGnomadParams
RefGnomadParams.description:
Download gnomAD allele frequencies: the 2.1.1 exome sites VCFs, or
build the 4.1 frequency table.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

release.description: 2.1.1: exome sites VCFs for hg19 and hg38 (hg38 lifted over). 4.1: native hg38 exomes+genomes, streamed (~900 GB, hours) into an allele-frequency-only table of ~5 GB; --threads sets parallel streams.

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

RefSpliceaiParams.title: RefSpliceaiParams
RefSpliceaiParams.description:
Download SpliceAI scores for hg38 (Ensembl, MANE SNVs), or index a
manual hg19 download; or delete the installed score files.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

delete.description: Delete the installed SpliceAI score files

RefAlphamissenseParams.title: RefAlphamissenseParams
RefAlphamissenseParams.description: Download AlphaMissense scores for hg19 and hg38, or delete them.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

delete.description: Delete the installed AlphaMissense score files

RefPharmgkbParams.title: RefPharmgkbParams
RefPharmgkbParams.description: Download PharmGKB annotations, or delete them.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

delete.description: Delete the installed PharmGKB annotation files

RefCaddParams.title: RefCaddParams
RefCaddParams.description: Download CADD v1.7 deleteriousness scores (~85 GB per build).

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

build.description: Genome build to download (default: hg38). Each is about 85 GB.

RefGerpParams.title: RefGerpParams
RefGerpParams.description: Download GERP++ conservation scores as a bigWig.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefAcmgDataParams.title: RefAcmgDataParams
RefAcmgDataParams.description:
Download the eight sources of ``vcf acmg`` (ClinVar and its protein
index, gnomAD v4.1 and its gene constraint, ClinGen, REVEL, SpliceAI,
phyloP) and the Ensembl GFF3 from their publishers, check them, and build
fastVEP's databases. Shows each source's terms; reruns resume.

chromosomes.description: Chromosomes for gnomAD, SpliceAI, REVEL and phyloP: chr22, chr1-22,chrX or all (default).

sa_dir.description: Folder to build the databases in (default: downloads/acmg/sa in the library).

spliceai_file.description: A GRCh38 SpliceAI VCF to use, such as Illumina's (default: the library's, downloaded from Ensembl when missing).

ensembl_release.description: Ensembl release of the GFF3; match your vep-rs cache.

site_data.description: per-run: don't build gnomAD and SpliceAI (877 GB streamed, 29 GB downloaded for a genome); vcf acmg reads each input's own sites of them. library builds them. Default: as the folder was built, else library.

dry_run.description: Show the sources, their terms, sizes and the disk needed; download nothing.

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RefMicroarrayTargetsParams.title: RefMicroarrayTargetsParams
RefMicroarrayTargetsParams.description:
Build the genome-wide hg19 and hg38 microarray targets
(``microarray/All_SNPs_<build>_ref.tab.gz``) from the bootstrap's chip
templates, or delete them. ``microarray`` builds a missing one itself.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

RepairFtdnaVcfParams.description:

IDs are all declared, so bcftools and VEP accept it. Legacy expressions
become IDs that keep their meaning (``DP=1`` becomes ``DP1``, ``QUAL=12``

VcfPharmcatParams.description:
Star-allele diplotypes and drug-response phenotypes from a GRCh38 VCF
with PharmCAT: ``<stem>.report.html``, ``.report.json`` and
``.phenotype.json``. Missing PharmCAT reference FASTA needs ``download``;
no sample data is sent to its public reference publisher.

download.description: Allow missing public reference/model downloads; no sample files or genotypes are uploaded. Hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md. Default: config allow_reference_downloads, else off.

input.description: The VCF to read when ``vcf_input`` is unset.

vcf_input.description: The VCF to read; wins over ``input``. On the CLI, --vcf-input defaults to config default_input_vcf when --input isn't given.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the VCF's folder).

absent_to_ref.description: Treat positions absent from the VCF as reference. Only for a whole-genome VCF that lists variants only (not a gVCF).

outside_call.description: PharmCAT outside-call file (gene<TAB>diplotype), e.g. from `typing cyp2d6` or `typing hla`. Repeatable; one call per gene.

confidence_depth.description: (LOW, HIGH): read depth below LOW labels a call low confidence, below HIGH moderate (default: config confidence_min_* and confidence_high_*).

confidence_gq.description: (LOW, HIGH): genotype quality below LOW labels a call low confidence, below HIGH moderate (default: config confidence_min_* and confidence_high_*).

VcfChainAnnotateParams.title: VcfChainAnnotateParams
VcfChainAnnotateParams.description:
Several annotations applied in turn, as ``chain_annotated.vcf.gz``;
steps whose tool or data is missing are skipped with a warning.

input.description: The VCF to read when ``vcf_input`` is unset.

vcf_input.description: The VCF to read; wins over ``input``. On the CLI, --vcf-input defaults to config default_input_vcf when --input isn't given.

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the VCF's folder).

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

annotations.description: Comma-separated list of annotations to apply in order (default: clinvar,revel,phylop,gnomad,vep).

keep_intermediates.description: Keep intermediate VCF files generated during the chain process.

input.description: BAM or CRAM to call.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

caller.description: SV caller to use (default: sniffles for ONT or --long-read, pbsv/sniffles for PacBio, detected or flagged; else delly). pbsv is PacBio-only and is refused for ONT reads.

VcfCallParams.title: VcfCallParams
VcfCallParams.description:
Call the chosen variant types in one run, each into the file its own
command writes: ``snps.vcf.gz`` (``vcf snp``), ``indels.vcf.gz``
(``vcf indel``), the SV caller's VCF (``vcf sv``) and ``cnv.vcf.gz``
(``vcf cnv``). With ``reference_evidence`` gvcf, SNPs and indels go into
``bcftools.g.vcf.gz`` alone. ``merge`` joins the parts, by position, into
``variants.vcf.gz`` (``variants.g.vcf.gz`` with the gVCF; output role
``merged_variants``) and removes them.

input.description: BAM or CRAM to call.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

types.description: Comma-separated variant types to call: snp and indel (bcftools), sv (as vcf sv picks the caller) and cnv (Delly). Default: snp,indel.

merge.description: Merge the called types into one variants.vcf.gz (+ .tbi), or variants.g.vcf.gz with the gVCF, in place of each type's own VCF.

reference_evidence.description: gvcf: write SNPs and indels as one gVCF, bcftools.g.vcf.gz (+ .tbi), with reference blocks, in place of snps.vcf.gz and indels.vcf.gz; none: the variant VCFs. Default: config reference_evidence, else none.

ploidy.description: SNP and indel ploidy name or value, as for vcf snp.

cnv_ploidy.description: CNV baseline ploidy, as vcf cnv's --ploidy (default: 2).

sv_caller.description: SV caller (default: as vcf sv picks: sniffles for ONT or long reads, pbsv/sniffles for PacBio, else delly).

pacbio.description: PacBio HiFi/CCS data, as for vcf sv.

ont.description: Oxford Nanopore data, as for vcf sv.

long_read.description: Long-read data, as for vcf sv.

ccs.description: pbsv CCS/HiFi thresholds, as for vcf sv.

tandem_repeats.description: Tandem-repeat BED for pbsv or Sniffles, as for vcf sv.

qc_min_depth.description: Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 15, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

VcfGatkParams.title: VcfGatkParams
VcfGatkParams.description:
Call small variants with GATK HaplotypeCaller into ``gatk.vcf.gz``
(flow mode for Ultima reads), or with Parabricks on a GPU.

input.description: BAM or CRAM to call.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

region.description: Comma-separated region(s) to call (e.g. chrM), or a BED file.

scatter.description: Opt-in Ultima flow-mode interval scattering, bounded by --threads and available RAM (6 GiB per worker, 4 GiB Java heap). Can change genotypes/annotations away from interval boundaries; default: one unscattered process.

gpu.description: Call on an NVIDIA GPU with Parabricks (Linux, Docker; see docs/hardware.md#nvidia-gpus-parabricks).

no_gpu_memory_check.description: Run on the GPU despite too little GPU or host memory; Parabricks' low-memory options are still chosen to fit.

qc_min_depth.description: Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 15, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

reference_evidence.description: gvcf also writes gatk.g.vcf.gz and its index (output roles reference_evidence, reference_evidence_index); the variant VCF is unchanged. None uses config reference_evidence, else none. See docs/reference-evidence.md.

VcfDeepvariantParams.title: VcfDeepvariantParams
VcfDeepvariantParams.description: Call small variants with DeepVariant into ``deepvariant.vcf.gz``.

input.description: BAM or CRAM to call.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

region.description: Region(s) to call (e.g. chrM) or BED files of them, separated by spaces (commas with gpu).

wes.description: Set model type to WES (default: WGS)

model_type.description: DeepVariant model type (default: ONT_R104 for detected ONT, ULTIMA for Ultima reads with their flow tags, else WGS). ONT_R104 supports R10.4.1 only and requires x86-64; Linux ARM64 supports WGS only. Use PACBIO for PacBio HiFi/CCS alignments.

checkpoint.description: A custom model: its directory, or a checkpoint prefix.

batch_size.description: call_variants batch size (upstream default: 1024; not Parabricks). Use 256 to lower TensorFlow peak RAM without changing models or precision; --threads controls make_examples shards, not this batch.

gpu.description: NVIDIA GPU (x86-64 Linux): WGS/ONT via wgse-deepvariant if set up, else Parabricks; Ultima: Google's GPU image (docs/hardware.md#nvidia-gpus-parabricks).

no_gpu_memory_check.description: Run on the GPU despite too little GPU or host memory; Parabricks' low-memory options are still chosen to fit.

no_preflight.description: Run despite too little disk or RAM (not recommended).

qc_min_depth.description: Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 15, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

reference_evidence.description: gvcf also writes deepvariant.g.vcf.gz and its index (output roles reference_evidence, reference_evidence_index); the variant VCF is unchanged. None uses config reference_evidence, else none. See docs/reference-evidence.md.

restart.description: Rerun every step, ignoring the steps an earlier run completed.

force_steps.description: Steps to rerun with the steps that use their outputs; None reruns none. Steps: stage_reads, make_examples, call_variants, postprocess_variants.

dry_run.description: Log which steps would run or be skipped, and why, and run none.

VcfPhaseParams.title: VcfPhaseParams
VcfPhaseParams.description:
Phase one sample's heterozygous calls with its reads into

VcfImputeParams.title: VcfImputeParams
VcfImputeParams.description:
Impute one GRCh38 sample's genotypes from the 1000 Genomes 30x panel
into ``imputed.vcf.gz``: low-coverage reads (``input``) with GLIMPSE2, or
a genotype-only VCF such as microarray calls (``vcf_input``) with Beagle 5.

input.description: Low-coverage BAM or CRAM to impute with GLIMPSE2 (about 0.5-8x).

vcf_input.description: Genotype-only VCF (e.g. chip calls) to impute with Beagle instead.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

memory.description: Memory per thread, e.g. '2G' (sorts: at most half the RAM in all); None picks a share of RAM (default: config memory_limit, else auto).

chromosomes.description: Chromosomes, e.g. chr20 or chr1-22 (default: every installed one).

min_info.description: Opt-in INFO/DR2 site filter; meaningful only for multi-sample cohorts.

VepRunParams.title: VepRunParams
VepRunParams.description: Annotate variants with VEP (see the module docstring).

input.description: VCF, BCF, BAM or CRAM to annotate, or a folder: every such file in it except earlier VEP outputs.

ref.description: Reference FASTA or reference library folder; resolved from the input's header when omitted (default: config reference_fasta).

outdir.description: Outputs (default: config output_directory, else wgse/ beside primary input; otherwise the input's folder).

threads.description: CPU threads; None picks a count for this machine (default: config cpu_threads, else auto).

engine.description: Engine, 'vep-rs' or 'ensembl' (default: config vep_engine, else 'vep-rs'; with only an Ensembl VEP cache, Ensembl VEP, warning vep_engine_fallback).

vep_cache.description: VEP cache folder (default: config vep_cache_directory, else the reference library's, else ~/.vep). VEP runs offline. If the cache is missing, vep_cache_missing tells you how to fetch it with vep download.

vep_assembly.description: Assembly VEP annotates against (default: the reference's build); a resolved FASTA of another build is not used. T2T-CHM13v2.0 needs vep-rs.

vcf_type.description: Variant type: 'sv' and 'cnv' add VEP's structural-variant options; 'auto' detects it from the input.

add_chr.description: Give VEP the input with a 'chr' prefix on chromosome names.

force.description: Force re-run even if output exists

preset.description: What VEP annotates: 'everything' (default), or 'fast' (about twice as fast: consequences, genes, MANE transcripts, SIFT and PolyPhen; no population frequencies, for which use 'vcf gnomad', and no HGVS)

ploidy_file.description: Ploidy file for calling a BAM or CRAM (default: the reference library's); wins over ploidy.

ploidy.description: bcftools ploidy name or value for calling a BAM or CRAM (default: the build's).

VepDownloadParams.title: VepDownloadParams
VepDownloadParams.description: Download and unpack Ensembl's VEP cache (see the module docstring).

engine.description: Engine, 'vep-rs' or 'ensembl' (default: config vep_engine, else 'vep-rs'; with only an Ensembl VEP cache, Ensembl VEP, warning vep_engine_fallback).
